info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Investment Portfolio Dividends-v3-spec
info.description: The Investment Portfolio Dividends API provides access to the dividend information associated with an investment portfolio. This endpoint allows users to retrieve a comprehensive list of dividends for their specified portfolios, helping them track income generated from their investments. Ideal for financial analysts, portfolio managers, and individual investors, this API supports the effective management of investment performance. Use cases include monitoring dividend distributions and analyzing portfolio cash flows.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to access the dividend information associated with their portfolio. It provides details about each dividend, including amounts, dates, and related stocks.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the dividend information associated with a specific portfolio. Ensure that the provided data adheres to the expected schema for successful processing.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of dividends.
